name: 86 Chaos 16.0.24 Vercel Function Configuration Fix
label: 86 Chaos 16.0.24 Vercel Function Configuration Fix
notes: Keeps the 16.0.23 compact professional UI refinement intact.
Replaces fragile per-file Vercel function patterns with wildcard function configuration that matches the API directory consistently.
Preserves existing API routes, scanner routes, cron routes, cache headers, security headers, Firebase wiring, and app behavior.
No Firebase credentials, rules, project IDs, environment values, or service-account wiring were changed.
releaseNotes: Fixes Vercel deployment failure where an explicit functions pattern for api/scan-invoice.js could be rejected as unmatched.
Uses broad api/**/*.js and api/**/*.py function configuration so existing serverless functions remain covered without depending on one brittle filename match.
Keeps invoice/menu scanners and long-running cron/API routes within the configured duration and memory envelope.
No UI, feature workflow, Firebase configuration, data model, or permission behavior was changed.
